concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-003 (pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h and peak RAM ≤ 7 GB) is not linked to any task. No task records measuring or asserting the total pipeline execution time or memory usage, so the criterion cannot be verified.

The data‑model entity ‘ProblemStatement’ (required by the data‑model spec) is not covered by any task. T007 defines Abstract, PatternCard, Proposal, and Rating classes but omits a task that creates or validates the ProblemStatement class.
